Everloot: census on. It records the race, class, level and faction of your characters and of players near you: ones you target, mouse over or group with, and ones the game shows a nameplate for (your nameplate settings decide which). Never their names, guilds, gear or where they are. It stays in this file unless the Everloot Desktop App, if you allowed the census there, or the everloot.app upload page sends it. /everloot census off stops it and deletes the rows.
